'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis]]
***[[Reactions to the 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis]]
****[[Russia–NATO relations]]
*****The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] says that [[Russia]] now has enough [[Russian Ground Forces|troops]] and [[military equipment]] in place in order to launch an invasion of [[Ukraine]] and warns [[Americans]] to leave the country within the next 48 hours. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-60355295 (BBC News)]
*****The [[Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office|British Foreign Office]] advises [[British national]]s to leave Ukraine immediately. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-invasion-russia-uk-us-putin-b2013417.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.gov.uk/government/news/british-nationals-advised-to-leave-ukraine-immediately (FCDO)]
*****It is announced that the [[United States Armed Forces]] will deploy 3,000 additional troops from the [[82nd Airborne Division]] to [[Poland]] in the "coming days" amid tensions with Russia. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/exclusive-us-send-3000-additional-troops-poland-officials-say-2022-02-11/ (Reuters)]
****[[Israel]] begins evacuating embassy staff and diplomats’ families from [[Kyiv]], and also orders a travel warning for all Israelis, saying that a large scale Russian offensive may occur soon. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-issues-travel-warning-for-ukraine-amid-russian-invasion-fears/ (''Times of Israel'')]
****[[Japan]] urges its citizens to leave Ukraine immediately. There are about 150 Japanese citizens currently living in Ukraine. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Politics/International-relations/Japan-urges-its-citizens-in-Ukraine-to-leave-immediately (Nikkei)]
****[[South Korea]] bans all travel to Ukraine and asks its citizens to leave Ukraine immediately. [https://www.newsweek.com/south-korea-bans-travel-ukraine-joins-us-asking-citizens-leave-1678448 (''Newsweek'')]
***Satellite imagery records Russia amassing more troops near the [[Russia–Ukraine border]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-says-russia-masses-more-troops-near-ukraine-invasion-could-come-any-time-2022-02-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**[[Israel]] announces the arrest of eight alleged [[Iran]]ian spies for organizing a plot to kill an Israeli businessman in [[Istanbul]] in retaliation for the 2020 assassination of the chief of [[Iran's nuclear program]], [[Mohsen Fakhrizadeh]], widely regarded to be the work of the Israeli [[intelligence agency]], [[Mossad]]. [[Turkey|Turkish]] intelligence shared with the Mossad apparently contributed to the arrests, and several Turkish operatives were among those arrested. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/turkish-media-iranian-cell-caught-while-planning-to-assassinate-israeli-in-istanbul/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Hong Kong]] reports a record 1,325 new [[COVID-19]] cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the territory-wide total of confirmed cases to 20,119. [https://amp.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/health-environment/article/3166625/coronavirus-hong-kong-expecting-another-record (''South China Morning Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 53,926 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,239,287. [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20220211000192 (''The Korea Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****The [[Government of France]] announces that [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask mandate]] in indoor public places will be eased beginning on February 28 as the number of COVID-19 declines. [https://www.euronews.com/2022/02/11/france-eases-rules-for-mandatory-face-masks-at-indoor-public-places (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] lifts its outdoor [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask mandate]] and reopens nightclubs as the number of COVID-19 cases declines. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220211-italy-ditches-covid-masks-outside (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 203,949 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 13.7 million. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/02/11/russia-sees-record-200k-covid-19-cases-a76341 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[Koala conservation]]
**The [[Australian Government]] officially lists the [[koala]] as an [[endangered species]] due to a combination of factors including [[drought]], [[bushfire]]s, disease and [[habitat loss]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2022/feb/11/koala-listed-as-endangered-after-australian-governments-fail-to-halt-its-decline (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Deforestation of the Amazon rainforest]], [[Deforestation in Brazil]]
**Satellite imagery shows 430 square kilometres of [[Amazon rainforest]] was [[deforested]] in January, five times more than last January. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-60333422 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Somaliland–Taiwan relations]]
**[[Somaliland]] [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Somaliland)|Foreign Minister]] [[Essa Kayd]] rebukes [[China]]'s apparent attempts to dictate the [[List of states with limited recognition|unrecognized]] breakaway state's foreign relations with [[Taiwan]] and reaffirms the state's recognition of the Republic of China. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/born-free-somaliland-says-china-cant-dictate-it-over-taiwan-2022-02-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Finland–United States relations]]
**[[Finland]] agrees to a [[$]]9.4 billion deal with the [[United States]] to purchase 64 [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35 Lightning II]] stealth fighter-jets for its [[Finnish Air Force|air force]]. The agreement also includes buying advanced [[surface-to-surface missile]]s from [[Lockheed Martin]] in order to upgrade the country's missile systems. The munition deliveries are expected to begin by 2025. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/finland-sign-deal-bringing-us-built-stealth-jets-russian-border-2022-02-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Canada convoy protest]]
**[[Premier of Ontario|Ontario Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] declares a state of emergency over the protest-related blockades in the City of [[Ottawa]] and at the [[Ambassador Bridge]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.6347810 (CBC)]
*[[Crime in Portugal]]
**[[Polícia de Segurança Pública|Portuguese police]], with help from the [[FBI]], arrest an 18-year-old boy for planning an armed attack on a university in [[Lisbon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/police-say-violent-attack-prevented-lisbon-university-suspect-arrested-2022-02-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[January 2022 Burkina Faso coup d'état|2022 Burkina Faso coup d'état]]
**[[Lieutenant colonel|Lt. Col.]] [[Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba]], leader of the [[military junta]], is declared [[List of heads of state of Burkina Faso|president]] by the [[Burkina Faso|Burkinabé]] Constitutional Council. His "election", deemed retroactively effective since the [[coup]] on January 24, will be made official by an [[inauguration]] on February 16. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/burkina-fasos-junta-leader-is-declared-president-by-council/ar-AATJFGQ?ocid=BingNews (AP)]
